name: Him & Me
source:
The story follows a girl in Korea, pressured by her grandfather to secure a husband before her upcoming birthday.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=33345]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了韩国的一个女孩在祖父的压力下在即将到来的生日之前找到一个丈夫的故事。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=33345]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
